power.jaymospowers.smoke.desc: You make smoke, and it's real: it billows, climbs, fills rooms, leaks under doors and drifts on the wind. Nothing sees through it but you.
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.starter: Faint Vapour Form: your legs turn to smoke and you fly on it, slower and with a thinner trail than you will; R again lands
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_1: Vapour Form: everything below your waist turns to smoke and you fly on it like the wind (Sprint to cruise, S to brake); shots pass through the smoke; R again lands. Fully mastered, cruising turns your whole body to smoke: nothing can hurt you, shots and creatures pass through, and you seep through anything short of a full block, but you can't strike or use abilities
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_2: Smokescreen (hold): thick smoke pours out of you for up to 10 s; it rises, fills the room and hides whoever is in it. Mastered, the cloud holds against the wind and lasts 3x longer
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_3: Smoke Bomb: throw a ball that bursts into a big cloud where it lands, blinding whoever is right by it
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.ability_4: Smother (hold): smoke wraps whoever you aim at (24 blocks), blinding and slowing them while their air runs out, then they choke
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.special: Smoke Jet (hold): a jet of smoke where you look (14 blocks) that lingers like your other smoke, drives smoke on and fills a ship's sails. Sneak + X: Smoke Step, come apart and re-form inside one of your own thick clouds under the crosshair (32 blocks, through walls)
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.mode: Smoke Sight (toggle): every creature standing in smoke within 32 blocks is outlined through walls (dark for the hostile), and your own smoke is barely drawn; costs a little hunger while on
power.jaymospowers.smoke.key.mode.name: Smoke Sight
message.jaymospowers.smoke_step_none: No thick smoke of yours there to step into.
